text:
ashley: During the onboarding workshop a user hit a weird stall: our sample app container never passed readiness probe. quick local run repro'd it.
sam: logs?
ashley: startup logs show `INFO: Uvicorn running` then nothing. curl /health hangs. top shows one Python thread pegged.
tom: did you run the docker image exactly like the quickstart? any env overrides?
ashley: default quickstart image. I dug in and saw sample_app/__init__.py creates an AsyncClient instance at module import and also schedules a background token refresher using `threading.Timer` that calls requests.post to refresh tokens every 30s.
sam: oof mixing requests (sync) and module-level AsyncClient is a classic event-loop starvation case if the sync fetch runs during startup. but why would it block the whole process?
ashley: our container env has a flaky egress in the lab so the first token refresh timed out; the refresh code has a retry loop with sleep(0.2) between attempts and it's called during import. that spin + blocking network calls prevented the event loop thread from scheduling uvicorn worker startup tasks.
tom: can you paste minimal repro?
ashley: repro snippet: ```python
# sample_import_block.py
import time
import requests
from httpx import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
# naive refresher run at import
for i in range(100):
    try:
        requests.post('http://127.0.0.1:1/timeout', timeout=0.1)
    except Exception:
        time.sleep(0.05)
```
sam: yep that will spin during import and prevent other tasks from starting when used in a container that spawns an asyncio loop on import.
ashley: quick workaround: lazy-init client in startup handler and make token refresher async + use anyio.to_thread.run_sync for existing sync code. swapping requests->httpx async fixed things immediately.
tom: longer term for SDK/samples: 1) replace module-level AsyncClient examples with a `get_client()` factory + contextmanager pattern, 2) update quickstart to show async token refresh example, 3) provide a `redwood.auth.AsyncRefreshAuth` helper that supports async token callbacks so users don't accidentally block.
sam: add a CI test that imports the sampleapp under a short timeout and fails if import takes >200ms. might catch accidental time.sleep in examples.
ashley: created ticket in SDK repo (#4231) with repro and proposed sample changes + test. linked docs PR to update quickstart.
ci-bot: CI: sampleapp-import-timeout test failed on commit 9c3fd; see build.log for details.
deploy-bot: Deployed branch ash/sample-lazy-client to staging for validation.
ashley: validated staging, readiness probes green now. thanks team! :rocket:
